title: [Bugfix][ROCm] Route non-divisor small-head MLA decode to Gluon on gfx950
body_opening:
Fixes #51232.

Kimi-K3 has 96 MLA query heads; at TP8 each rank gets 12 local heads.
12 is not a divisor of 16, so `use_gluon_decode` returned `False` in
"auto" mode, routing single-token decode to the padded ASM persistent
path. That path pads 12 heads to 16 and asks AITER for a `{bf16, fp8,
gqa=16, qseqlen=1}` kernel, which does not exist on gfx950 — every
rank crashes with `cannot get heuristic kernel` before the server
starts.

The Gluon MLA decode kernel handles any head count natively (no
padding), so the fix is to prefer Gluon for ALL small-head counts on
gfx950 in "auto" mode, not just divisors of 16. On gfx942 (no Gluon
build) the ASM path is still used for all counts — no behavior

title: [ROCm] Fix EAGLE spec-decode verify silently sampling greedy on HIP
body_opening:
## Problem

EAGLE spec-decode verify has been committing `argmax` on ROCm, ignoring
`temperature` and `top_p` entirely, with nothing in the log saying so. At
`temp > 0` it degenerates into repetition loops.

The cause is one line in `eagle_sample`:

```python
if sampling_info.is_all_greedy or _is_cpu or _is_npu or _is_hip or _is_xpu:
    target_predict = torch.argmax(next_token_logits, dim=-1)
```

`_is_hip` sits next to `is_all_greedy`, so HIP takes the greedy path
unconditionally. It is there because the sampling branch needs
`tree_speculative_sampling_target_only`, `top_k_renorm_prob` and
`top_p_renorm_prob`, all of which are CUDA/MUSA-only in `sgl_kernel`.

- The c4/c128 compressed-store `out_loc` offset (`out_loc + unified_swa_pages`) was recomputed in every layer's compressor store, emitting an extra element-wise int-add kernel per layer on the decode hot path. Move it into a single per-step computation in the attention metadata.
-  The unified_kv per-stepmetadata was lots of fields on the attention metadata. Group them into one dataclass for unified management (non-unified runs then carry a single None instead of many unused fields).
-  `is_unified_kv_triton()` only has a HIP implementation. Guard it with `is_hip()` so non-HIP code paths never take it even if the env var is set.
